answer_1.quote: In the pursuit of ever more powerful image description systems, we need evaluation metrics that provide a clear window into model capabilities.

answer_2.quote: We then use this experimental data to evaluate two very different referenceless metrics: CLIPScore, which assesses a description's quality relative to its associated image, and SPURTS, which relies only on linguistic properties of the text.

answer_4.quote: After obtaining contextual image descriptions, we designed a description evaluation study which we conducted with BLV as well as sighted participants.
answer_4.guideline: Each description was evaluated according to five dimensions: Overall quality, Imaginability of the image from the description, Relevance and Irrelevance of the mentioned details, and image Fit to the article.
